statement: TWO LEVELS ONLY. This is a refinement TREND, not a grid-convergence index. Two points give a direction and a magnitude of movement. They do NOT give an observed order of accuracy, a Richardson extrapolation, or an uncertainty band -- all three need a third point. Report it as a trend and say the band is absent. gci_M is MARGINAL: predicted 12.0 GiB against a 11.3 GiB budget. The memory law is a two-point fit, so that gap is not a refusal and it is not a pass either -- it is a measurement waiting to be taken. Run it under run_campaign.py --watch-memory, which samples resident set size and swap and aborts on sustained paging, rather than finding out after eight hours that the answer came from disk.
can_this_host_become_bigger: No. gci_F needs 23.0 GiB and the Windows host has 15.86 GiB of physical memory in total, so no .wslconfig change reaches it. A third level needs a different machine.
